_readme: What every new farm starts with. Change a number, save this file, reload the game (F5), then start a new farm.
Use whole numbers. If something here is wrong, the game keeps its built-in amount for it and the title screen says what to fix.
food is capped by the farmhouse pantry (10), water by its barrels (15), and ripeCrops by the field's first 4 plots.
extraShotguns and extraScythes join the 2 shotguns and 2 scythes in the warehouse, for good.
After changing the kit, run  node balance-sim.mjs  in the game folder: a bot plays 12 farms with it.
